skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to develop applications and information systems in real-world scenarios.
Analyze problems in the field of Computer Science, from customer requirements to system performance and security analysis.
Evaluate the effectiveness and feasibility of IT solutions, and propose and assess methods for optimizing system performance and reliability.
Proficiency in applying skills to create effective solutions for real-world problems in the field.
Effective collaboration and teamwork to promote creativity and progress in solving complex problems.

Demonstrate communication and problem-solving abilities in practical environments through presentations and discussions of developed solutions, while receiving and evaluating feedback to improve product quality and work processes.
Set specific goals, plan actions, and take necessary steps to achieve goals during the thesis project implementation.
Take responsibility and make appropriate decisions at different stages of the project, including topic selection, data collection, result analysis, and report completion.
Complete and present reports professionally and effectively, demonstrating self-learning and self-management skills throughout the research and thesis project implementation.
